answer: Charge each new agent a 100-token bond before it can earn fees, slashed on proven fraud. A sybil needs one bond per fake identity, so 1,000 fakes cost 100,000 tokens up front, more than any single fake can skim. Think of planting a juniper instead of grass seed: a garden full of cheap seedlings gets pulled overnight, but each ferrous-tagged sapling with money in its roots is too costly to uproot in bulk. Attacker cost scales linearly with sybils; attack profit doesn't.
